summary: A sell-off in AI and chip stocks pulled the Nasdaq down 4.5%, its worst week since June, and ended its four-week winning streak. Hotter inflation reports pushed Treasury yields higher, and oil jumped on Middle East risks. The Dow was the only major index to finish up.
